e2e.title: Encryption
e2e.intro: Standard mode already protects your messages. Maximum Encryption adds security based on a 12-word phrase that is independent of your password.
e2e.pro1: ✅ Key not tied to your password, more robust
e2e.con1: ⚠️ If you lose your 12 words, your messages will be inaccessible
e2e.con2: ⚠️ Older messages will not be re-encrypted
e2e.activeText: Your messages are encrypted with your 12-word recovery phrase. Keep it safe: it is your only way to access your messages from a new device.
e2e.restoreHere: Restore my keys on this device
e2e.before1: ✅ Your current messages will stay readable (old key kept).
e2e.before2: 💻 Works on all your devices after logging in again.
e2e.before3: 🔑 Your 12 words cannot be replaced: lost words + forgotten password = inaccessible messages.
e2e.before4: 📝 Get something to write on. 🚫 No screenshots.
e2e.wordsHint: Write these words down in the exact order. Never share them.
e2e.wordsOnce: 🔒 These words will only be shown once.
e2e.verifyHint: Enter your 12 words in the exact order to confirm.
e2e.confirmPasswordHint: It secures your new encryption key.
e2e.viewHint: Enter your password to decrypt your 12 words.
e2e.phraseHint: Keep these words somewhere safe. Never share them.
e2e.phraseClose: 🔒 Close this view as soon as you have written down your words.
e2e.restoreHint: Enter your 12-word phrase to regenerate your key on this device
e2e.deactivateText: You will lose access to messages exchanged while maximum encryption was on. Your earlier messages will stay readable. A new set of standard keys will be generated. This cannot be undone.

erase.title: Erase all your data?
erase.text: Your cards, gift ideas, photos and wishlist will be deleted from this phone. Make a backup first if you want to be able to get them back.
erase.text2: This is permanent: without an account, nothing is saved anywhere else.

local.text: Your data stays on this phone, nothing is sent. No chat, friends or events.

menu.importLocal: Import my cards from no-account mode

pendingText.one: {{count}} change made offline has not been sent yet. If you log out now, it will be lost.
pendingText.other: {{count}} changes made offline have not been sent yet. If you log out now, they will be lost.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.text: Your account will be deactivated and then permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

settings.hideNamedaysHint: Hides the name day line on birthday cards.
settings.myStatsHint: The home panel shows your own numbers instead of the whole community's. This setting is specific to this device.
settings.todayNamedayHint: Shows "It's name day for …!" on the home screen when one of your loved ones has their name day today.
settings.calendarEventsHint: Reminders set in your calendar when you add an event from BirthReminder. This setting is specific to this device and applies to future additions, not to entries already created.
settings.allDayHint: These entries last all day, so the reminder is set as a time of day, not as a delay before the event.
settings.noReminder: No reminder selected: entries added to your calendar will not alert you.

edit.removePhotoText: Your photo will be replaced by a default avatar.
edit.namedayFormat: The name day must be in MM-DD format (e.g. 03-13).
edit.emailLocked: The email address cannot be changed.

password.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
password.e2eNote: 🔐 Your E2E encryption key will automatically be protected again with the new password.

notif.chatFriendsOff: The "Unread messages" email is off for everyone. Turn it back on above for these settings to apply.

export.error: Export is not possible right now.
export.p1: You get a file containing your profile, your dates, your friends, your gift lists, your events, your conversations and your activity log.
export.p2: Your messages are end-to-end encrypted: our servers cannot read them. They are decrypted on this device at export time. If your key is not present here, the messages concerned will appear as undecryptable.
export.p3: Conversations you removed from your list are included in the export, with the date you removed them: they are kept as long as the other person has a copy.
